newCompleted.title: Jitters' Growling Gut
newCompleted.briefing: I've been stuck hiding in this ghost town for weeks, and I haven't eaten anything but grubs and weeds! I need some decent food,…
newCompleted.objective: Speak with Chef Grual in Darkshire about food for Jitters.
newCompleted.story: Jitters is alive among the abandoned houses; his immediate need is a proper meal.

newCompleted.title: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs
newCompleted.briefing: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs are a house favorite! Sure, I can make you some. But first I'll need the supplies. Bring me 10 Lean Wolf…
newCompleted.objective: Bring Chef Grual ten Lean Wolf Flanks.
newCompleted.story: A completed kitchen commission brings an ordinary comfort back into the story.

newCompleted.title: Dusky Crab Cakes
newCompleted.briefing: I'll let you in on a little secret - Dusky "Crab" Cakes are really made from spider legs! I know it's a bit disgusting,…
newCompleted.objective: Bring Chef Grual six Gooey Spider Legs for the cakes.
newCompleted.story: The misleading name hides Grual’s unusual ingredient. The onward delivery to Jitters remains open.

newCompleted.title: Supplies from Darkshire
newCompleted.briefing: Oh, what is a poor old man to do? I need some supplies from Darkshire, but the village is so far away and I…
newCompleted.objective: Speak with Madame Eva about Ghost Hair Thread for Abercrombie.
newCompleted.story: The supply inquiry is complete; Ghost Hair Thread is the active next stage.

newCompleted.title: Raven Hill
newCompleted.briefing: Something's amiss at Raven Hill, Xuthar. Calor swears that someone--or something--is haunting the buildings there. Two nights running he's noticed the shadows moving, and…
newCompleted.objective: Investigate the reported haunting at Raven Hill and find Jitters.
newCompleted.story: An apparent haunting leads to a frightened survivor.

newCompleted.title: Deliveries to Sven
newCompleted.briefing: Do you know Sven? Now, there is a man who does the work of the Light! He and his followers keep a camp at…
newCompleted.objective: Deliver the provided supplies to Sven Yorgen’s camp.
newCompleted.story: Aid reaches the isolated western camp.

newCompleted.title: The Hermit
newCompleted.briefing: There was an old man who used to come into town to buy supplies rather frequently, but I haven't seen him for quite some…
newCompleted.objective: Check on Abercrombie near Raven Hill Cemetery.
newCompleted.story: The welfare visit is complete, and the hermit’s further requests have begun.

newCompleted.title: Wolves at Our Heels
newCompleted.briefing: Sven and I have dangerous days ahead of us, what with the Necromancer to the east and all. And out here alone as we…
newCompleted.objective: Defeat twelve Starving Dire Wolves and eight Rabid Dire Wolves for Lars at Sven’s camp.
newCompleted.story: The threat to camp supplies and the surrounding paths has been reduced.

newCompleted.title: The Valor Family
newCompleted.briefing: In dark times like these, it's important we remember our heroes as much as our foes. Darkshire would not still be standing if it…
newCompleted.objective: Find the Raven Hill Tome and bring it to Sirra Von’Indi.
newCompleted.story: The recovered history answers the first family inquiry; Ira’s Dagger remains a separate active obligation.

interpretation: Nine newly verified completions since the published 21 November arrival snapshot. The interval spans late 21 November and 22 November; individual hand-in dates, times and objective counters are not returned. The photos document five late-evening frames on 21 November and twelve morning frames on 22 November. Level 25 is confirmed by player and official profile.
